items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: he got us together and we played a few jobs

ctx.x: on to make names for themselves in the music.

Well,we had a guy come in from... I don't know where Goofus Carnell come in from...but Chauncey Johns came to my hometown. He was from Kansas City and he was a suave, debonair type person. He played piano. And he started to be friendly with a woman there that was well off and he staid around for a while. So he decided to form a band and so he got us together and we played a few jobs. We played Idlewilde, Michigan, and then...we didn't do too much. But Sy Jenkins and myself and Howard went up to Idlewilde,…
